_provenance.note: Hand-extracted zkgroup KeyPair-level Schnorr signature KAT. Distinct from the higher-level ServerSecretParams.Sign KAT: this one exercises the raw SignatureKeyPair generated from a SHO labelled 'Test_Signature' and absorbed with TEST_ARRAY_32 (0..31). The same SHO is then used to derive the 32-byte randomness for poksho::sign over TEST_ARRAY_32_1 message.
